# Maahir Garg

> Maahir Garg is an AI Engineer at GIC and a Computer Science & Quantitative
> Finance student at the National University of Singapore (NUS), based in
> Singapore. He builds agentic LLM tooling for classified-data environments
> and co-invented a multimodal hand-tracking framework on Apple Vision Pro
> for stroke rehabilitation (patent application in progress).

Key facts:

- Role: AI Engineer at GIC (Singapore's sovereign wealth fund), building an
  internal agentic CLI agent and LLM pipelines that automate audit workflows.
- Education: Bachelor of Computing (Honours) in Computer Science with a
  Second Major in Quantitative Finance, National University of Singapore
  (2023–2027).
- Research: multimodal iPhone + Apple Vision Pro hand-tracking framework for
  stroke rehabilitation at Interactive 3D Lab, 89% cross-device accuracy
  (patent application in progress); BERT quantization/pruning (~69% smaller,
  <0.5% F1 loss); PEFT/BitFit experiments on LLM reasoning.
- Teaching: Algorithms, Data Structures, and Discrete Structures at NUS
  across three semesters (4.8/5.0 student rating).
- Interests: photography, badminton, Formula 1, chess.
- Contact: maahirrgarg@gmail.com

FAQ:

- Who is Maahir Garg? An AI Engineer at GIC and a Computer Science &
  Quantitative Finance student at the National University of Singapore
  (NUS), based in Singapore.
- What does Maahir Garg work on? Agentic LLM tooling for classified-data
  environments at GIC, including an internal agentic CLI agent for an
  11-person team and pipelines that automate audit workflows end-to-end.
- Where is Maahir Garg based? Singapore. He studies at NUS and works at
  GIC, both in Singapore.
- What has Maahir Garg built? A multimodal hand-tracking framework on
  Apple Vision Pro for stroke rehabilitation (patent application in
  progress); an internal CLI agent at GIC; quantization and pruning work on
  BERT (~69% size reduction with <0.5% F1 loss); and PEFT/BitFit
  experiments on LLM reasoning.
- How do you contact Maahir Garg? Email maahirrgarg@gmail.com, or via
  https://maahir-garg.vercel.app/contact.
